title: Evaluation of the partition polynomial
statement: Let $p$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $z$ be an $n$-dimensional sign vector, and let $\pi$ map the $n$ coordinates to $m$ coordinates. The partition polynomial associated with $p,z,\pi$, evaluated at any $m$-dimensional sign vector $w$, equals $p\bigl((z_iw_{\pi(i)})_{i=1}^n\bigr)$.
